new_lessons: WSA884x confirms WSA SoundWire amplifier conversion transfers when binding provides supply and port-count deltas.
Dual-supply codecs should use binding-derived regulator_bulk_data instead of single-vdd inference.
The WSA883x hwmon/reset/SDW identity pattern is reusable across WSA884x on first attempt.
Object consolidation can be planned from upstream Kconfig/Makefile, but retaining local regmap/table files may be safer for replay patches.
